summary: Discussion-sourced signals: xAI/Grok data leak, OpenAI Workspace Agents outage, multiple operator safety incidents (SSH forwarding, destructive agent commands), plus rising infra primitives (sandbox runtimes, MCP startups) and mixed-quality self-hosted agent chatter. | Vendor announcements: Bedrock agent APIs and web-search, Google Gemini Decisions, JetBrains Air GA, Modal sandbox scaling/maintenance, E2B sandbox identity and workflow, Mistral model+Studio, and two GHSA security advisories. | GitHub snapshot: multiple vendor releases (OpenAI, Vercel, Anthropic, Browser-Use) plus rising agent harnesses and security tooling; lacking social/operator reports for field workflows. | Package-index snapshot: multiple MCP/agent SDKs, VS Code agent extensions, memory and security extensions, and vendor libs (OpenAI/Anthropic). High-volume VS Code extensions and official vendor packages are highest-confidence; many single-repo MCP servers and agent toolkits need corroboration.
